name: obsidian-feishu-lark-cli-sync
description: Obsidian plugin that publishes and syncs Markdown notes to Feishu/Lark Docs through lark-cli.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-embedded-helpers.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-embedded-helpers.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node test/test-link-rewrite.mjs && node test/test-folder-path.mjs && node test/test-note-content.mjs && node test/test-lark-sync-core.mjs && node test/test-pre-push.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: wanghuan
